qa_pair.question: Using the macro data tools, find the monthly series of the US effective federal funds rate. What was its value for July 2019? Answer with the number only.

On what date did the ECB deposit facility rate first become positive after its negative-rate era? Answer in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Take the seasonally adjusted US unemployment rate for September 2019 and subtract the value for October 2009. What is the result in percentage points? Answer with the number only.
Find the month in which the US unemployment rate peaked during 2020. What was the monthly US effective federal funds rate in that same month? Answer with the number only.
Price a 1-year (365-day) European call option with spot 100, strike 100, a 5% risk-free rate, 20% volatility and no dividends using Black-Scholes. What is its value rounded to 2 decimals?

A 90-day European put with strike 105 on a stock trading at 100 costs 7.50. With a 3% risk-free rate, what is its Black-Scholes implied volatility in percent, rounded to 1 decimal? Answer with the number only.
What is the Black-Scholes delta of a European put with spot 50, strike 55, 182 days to expiry, a 2% risk-free rate and 30% volatility, rounded to 2 decimals?
Which tool exposed by this MCP server requires the user's approval in the terminal for every call made by an external agent? Answer with the exact tool name.
